name: Tomato-Garlic Vegetable Spaghetti
summary: Mild Indian-style vegetable spaghetti with a thick tomato-garlic sauce, carrot, capsicum, sweet corn and herbs.

items.preparation: Borges Durum Wheat Pasta Spaghetti was used in the successful trial
stalk, seeds and membrane removed; cut into short strips
roughly cut and blended without water
MAGGI Rich Tomato Ketchup was used; do not use Hot & Sweet ketchup
approximately 2 teaspoons total at 1×; the user's best recall, not a precisely measured confirmed quantity
leaves and tender stems finely chopped

preparation.after: Use roughly 3–4 medium tomatoes as approximate preparation guidance. Cut roughly and blend smooth or slightly coarse with no added water.
Cut to around 5–7 mm; do not slice into strips.
The tested batch used approximately 4–5 large cloves.
Make the strips about 3–4 cm long and 3–4 mm thick.
Remove the stalk, seeds and membrane. Cut into short strips about 3–4 cm long and 5–7 mm thick; slightly thicker than the carrot is fine.
Frozen corn may be used directly.
Use both leaves and tender stems.

cookingMethod.lead: Bring to a rolling boil and add:

cookingMethod.after: Let it soften, gently push it into the water, and stir so it does not stick.

cookingMethod.text: For the Borges spaghetti used in the trial, the packet guidance was approximately 10 minutes. Start tasting around 9 minutes; cook about 10 minutes, or 30–60 seconds longer only if still too firm.

cookingMethod.after: Drain the spaghetti and do not rinse.
Cook for about 3 minutes, until soft and translucent but not browned.
Cook for 30–45 seconds, until fragrant without browning.
Cook for 3–4 minutes. The capsicum should retain a slight bite.
Cook uncovered over medium heat for about 6–8 minutes, until the raw tomato smell is gone, the colour deepens, and the mixture is thick rather than watery.
Mix and cook over medium-low heat for about 1 minute. The sauce-stage salt is an approximate recall, unlike the confirmed pasta-water salt.
Simmer for about 2 minutes. If the tomato mixture is already loose, add the reserved water gradually rather than making the sauce watery.
Toss over low-medium heat for about 2 minutes, until the sauce clings to the spaghetti.

servingSuggestions: Serve hot while the tomato-garlic sauce is clinging to the spaghetti.
notes: The successfully tested batch was cooked on 26 September 2026 and had good spice balance and texture.
The target is a mild Indian-style tomato-garlic flavour with sauce that coats the spaghetti instead of pooling like curry or gravy.
Keep the carrot, capsicum and corn distinct, with some bite remaining in the capsicum.
The 1 1/2 teaspoons crystal salt in the pasta water was confirmed; the approximately 2 teaspoons salt used during the sauce/cooking stage is the user's best recall and was not precisely measured.
